versos.grego: Καὶ συνάγονται πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καί τινες τῶν γραμματέων ἐλθόντες ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων.

controles.web: Then the Pharisees, and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Os fariseus, e alguns dos escribas, que tinham vindo de Jerusalém, reuniram-se com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδόντες τινὰς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ὅτι κοιναῖς χερσίν, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἀνίπτοις, ἐσθίουσιν τοὺς ἄρτους,—

controles.web: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is, unwashed, hands, they found fault.
controles.kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
controles.livre: E viram que alguns dos discípulos dele comiam pão com mãos impuras, isto é, sem lavar.

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐὰν μὴ πυγμῇ νίψωνται τὰς χεῖρας οὐκ ἐσθίουσιν, κρατοῦντες τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων,

controles.web: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
controles.kjv: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
controles.livre: (Pois os fariseus, e todos os judeus, mantendo a tradição dos antigos, se não lavarem bastante as mãos, não comem.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπ’ ἀγορᾶς ἐὰν μὴ ῥαντίσωνται οὐκ ἐσθίουσιν, καὶ ἄλλα πολλά ἐστιν ἃ παρέλαβον κρατεῖν, βαπτισμοὺς ποτηρίων καὶ ξεστῶν καὶ χαλκίων,—

controles.web: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace, unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
controles.kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
controles.livre: E, quando voltam da rua, se não se lavarem, não comem; e há muitas outras coisas que se encarregam de guardar, como lavar os copos, as vasilhas, e os utensílios de metal).

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπερωτῶσιν αὐτὸν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς Διὰ τί οὐ περιπατοῦσιν οἱ μαθηταί σου κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, ἀλλὰ κοιναῖς χερσὶν ἐσθίουσιν τὸν ἄρτον;

controles.web: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
controles.kjv: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
controles.livre: Depois os fariseus e os escribas lhe perguntaram: Por que os teus discípulos não andam conforme a tradição dos antigos, em vez de comerem pão com as mãos impuras?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Καλῶς ἐπροφήτευσεν Ἡσαΐας περὶ ὑμῶν τῶν ὑποκριτῶν, ὡς γέγραπται ὅτι Οὗτος ὁ λαὸς τοῖς χείλεσίν με τιμᾷ, ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόρρω ἀπέχει ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ·

controles.web: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written,  ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
controles.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
controles.livre: E ele lhes respondeu: Bem profetizou Isaías acerca de vós, hipócritas! Como está escrito: Este povo me honra com os lábios, mas o seu coração está longe de mim.

versos.grego: μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με, διδάσκοντες διδασκαλίας ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων·

controles.web: But in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
controles.kjv: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
controles.livre: Eles, porém, me honram em vão, ensinando como doutrinas mandamentos humanos.

versos.grego: ἀφέντες τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ κρατεῖτε τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
controles.kjv: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
controles.livre: Vós deixais o mandamento de Deus, e mantendes a tradição humana.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Καλῶς ἀθετεῖτε τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἵνα τὴν παράδοσιν ὑμῶν τηρήσητε.

controles.web: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
controles.livre: E dizia-lhes: Vós dispensais o mandamento de Deus para guardardes a vossa tradição;

versos.grego: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ εἶπεν Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου, καί Ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα θανάτῳ τελευτάτω.

controles.web: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
controles.kjv: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
controles.livre: porque Moisés disse: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe. E quem maldisser ao pai ou à mãe terá de morrer.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δὲ λέγετε Ἐὰν εἴπῃ ἄνθρωπος τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί Κορβᾶν, ὅ ἐστιν Δῶρον, ὃ ἐὰν ἐξ ἐμοῦ ὠφεληθῇς,

controles.web: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban, that is to say, given to God”;’
controles.kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
controles.livre: Mas vós dizeis: Se o homem disser ao pai ou à mãe: Tudo o que te puder aproveitar de mim é corbã (isto é, oferta),

versos.grego: οὐκέτι ἀφίετε αὐτὸν οὐδὲν ποιῆσαι τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί,

controles.web: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
controles.kjv: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
controles.livre: então não lhe deixais mais nada fazer por seu pai ou por sua mãe.

versos.grego: ἀκυροῦντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ παραδόσει ὑμῶν ᾗ παρεδώκατε· καὶ παρόμοια τοιαῦτα πολλὰ ποιεῖτε.

controles.web: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
controles.kjv: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
controles.livre: Assim invalidaias a palavra de Deus por vossa tradição, que ordenastes; e fazeis muitas coisas semelhantes a estas.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος πάλιν τὸν ὄχλον ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἀκούσατέ μου πάντες καὶ σύνετε.

controles.web: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
controles.kjv: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
controles.livre: E chamando para si toda a multidão, disse-lhes: Ouvi-me todos, e entendei:

versos.grego: οὐδέν ἐστιν ἔξωθεν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς αὐτὸν ὃ δύναται κοινῶσαι αὐτόν· ἀλλὰ τὰ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκπορευόμενά ἐστιν τὰ κοινοῦντα τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

controles.web: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
controles.kjv: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
controles.livre: Nada há fora do ser humano que nele entre que o possa contaminar; mas o que dele sai, isso é o que contamina o ser humano.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς οἶκον ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου, ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν παραβολήν.

controles.web: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
controles.kjv: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
controles.livre: Quando Jesus deixou a multidão e entrou em casa, seus discípulos lhe perguntaram sobre a parábola.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀσύνετοί ἐστε; οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἔξωθεν εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς τὸν ἄνθρωπον οὐ δύναται αὐτὸν κοινῶσαι,

controles.web: He said to them, “Are you thus without understanding also? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
controles.kjv: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Também vós estais assim sem entendimento? Não entendeis que tudo o que de fora entra no ser humano não o pode contaminar?

versos.grego: ὅτι οὐκ εἰσπορεύεται αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἀλλ’ εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν, καὶ εἰς τὸν ἀφεδρῶνα ἐκπορεύεται, καθαρίζων πάντα τὰ βρώματα;

controles.web: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods?”
controles.kjv: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
controles.livre: Pois não entra no seu coração, mas, sim, no ventre, e sai para a privada. (Assim, ele declarou como limpas todas as comidas).

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν δὲ ὅτι Τὸ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκπορευόμενον, ἐκεῖνο κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

controles.web: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
controles.kjv: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
controles.livre: E dizia: O que sai do ser humano, isso contamina o ser humano.

versos.grego: ἔσωθεν γὰρ ἐκ τῆς καρδίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων οἱ διαλογισμοὶ οἱ κακοὶ ἐκπορεύονται, πορνεῖαι, κλοπαί, φόνοι,

controles.web: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
controles.kjv: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
controles.livre: Pois é de dentro do coração humano que vêm os maus pensamentos, os pecados sexuais, os roubos, os homicídios, os adultérios,

versos.grego: μοιχεῖαι, πλεονεξίαι, πονηρίαι, δόλος, ἀσέλγεια, ὀφθαλμὸς πονηρός, βλασφημία, ὑπερηφανία, ἀφροσύνη·

controles.web: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
controles.kjv: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
controles.livre: as ganâncias, as maldades, o engano, a depravação, o olho malicioso, a blasfêmia, a soberba, a insensatez.

versos.grego: πάντα ταῦτα τὰ πονηρὰ ἔσωθεν ἐκπορεύεται καὶ κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

controles.web: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”
controles.kjv: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
controles.livre: Todos estes males procedem de dentro, e contaminam o ser humano.

versos.grego: Ἐκεῖθεν δὲ ἀναστὰς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια Τύρου. Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς οἰκίαν οὐδένα ἤθελεν γνῶναι, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθη λαθεῖν·

controles.web: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
controles.kjv: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
controles.livre: Jesus levantou-se dali e foi para a região de Tiro. Ele entrou numa casa, e não queria que ninguém soubesse disso, mas não pôde se esconder.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ εὐθὺς ἀκούσασα γυνὴ περὶ αὐτοῦ, ἧς εἶχεν τὸ θυγάτριον αὐτῆς πνεῦμα ἀκάθαρτον, ἐλθοῦσα προσέπεσεν πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
controles.kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
controles.livre: E logo uma mulher, cuja filhinha tinha um espírito imundo, assim que ouviu falar dele, veio, e prostrou-se a seus pés.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἦν Ἑλληνίς, Συροφοινίκισσα τῷ γένει· καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτὸν ἵνα τὸ δαιμόνιον ἐκβάλῃ ἐκ τῆς θυγατρὸς αὐτῆς.

controles.web: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
controles.kjv: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
controles.livre: Esta mulher era grega, de nacionalidade sirofenícia; e rogava-lhe que expulsasse o demônio de sua filha.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτῇ Ἄφες πρῶτον χορτασθῆναι τὰ τέκνα· οὐ γάρ ἐστιν καλόν λαβεῖν τὸν ἄρτον τῶν τέκνων καὶ τοῖς κυναρίοις βαλεῖν.

controles.web: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
controles.kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
controles.livre: Mas  Jesus  lhe disse: Deixa primeiro que os filhos se fartem; porque não é bom tomar o pão dos filhos, e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ἀπεκρίθη καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί, Κύριε· καὶ τὰ κυνάρια ὑποκάτω τῆς τραπέζης ἐσθίουσιν ἀπὸ τῶν ψιχίων τῶν παιδίων.

controles.web: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
controles.kjv: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
controles.livre: Porém ela lhe respondeu: Sim Senhor; mas também os cachorrinhos comem debaixo da mesa, das migalhas que os filhos deixam.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Διὰ τοῦτον τὸν λόγον ὕπαγε, ἐξελήλυθεν ἐκ τῆς θυγατρός σου τὸ δαιμόνιον.

controles.web: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
controles.livre: Então ele lhe disse: Por esta palavra, vai, o demônio já saiu da tua filha.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπελθοῦσα εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς εὗρεν τὸ παιδίον βεβλημένον ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην καὶ τὸ δαιμόνιον ἐξεληλυθός.

controles.web: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
controles.kjv: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
controles.livre: Quando ela chegou à sua casa, encontrou que o demônio já havia saído, e a criança estava deitada sobre a cama.

versos.grego: Καὶ πάλιν ἐξελθὼν ἐκ τῶν ὁρίων Τύρου ἦλθεν διὰ Σιδῶνος εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὁρίων Δεκαπόλεως.

controles.web: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the region of Decapolis.
controles.kjv: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
controles.livre: Então Jesus voltou a sair da região de Tiro e veio por Sidom para o mar da Galilea, por meio da região de Decápolis.

versos.grego: Καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτῷ κωφὸν καὶ μογιλάλον, καὶ παρακαλοῦσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα ἐπιθῇ αὐτῷ τὴν χεῖρα.

controles.web: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
controles.kjv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
controles.livre: E trouxeram-lhe um surdo que dificilmente falava, e rogaram-lhe que pusesse a mão sobre ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπολαβόμενος αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου κατ’ ἰδίαν ἔβαλεν τοὺς δακτύλους αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτοῦ καὶ πτύσας ἥψατο τῆς γλώσσης αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.
controles.kjv: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
controles.livre: E tomando-o em separado da multidão, pôs os seus dedos nos ouvidos dele, cuspiu, e tocou-lhe a língua.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἐστέναξεν, καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ἐφφαθά, ὅ ἐστιν Διανοίχθητι.

controles.web: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!”  that is, “Be opened!”
controles.kjv: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
controles.livre: Depois, levantando os olhos ao céu, suspirou, e disse: Efatá, (isto é, abre-te).

versos.grego: καὶ ἠνοίγησαν αὐτοῦ αἱ ἀκοαί, καὶ εὐθὺς ἐλύθη ὁ δεσμὸς τῆς γλώσσης αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλει ὀρθῶς.

controles.web: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
controles.kjv: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
controles.livre: Os ouvidos dele se abriram, e imediatamente o que prendia sua língua se soltou, e passou a falar bem.

versos.grego: καὶ διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ λέγωσιν· ὅσον δὲ αὐτοῖς διεστέλλετο, αὐτοὶ μᾶλλον περισσότερον ἐκήρυσσον.

controles.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
controles.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
controles.livre: Jesus lhes mandou que a ninguém dissessem; porém, quanto mais lhes mandava, mais divulgavam.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑπερπερισσῶς ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες Καλῶς πάντα πεποίηκεν, καὶ τοὺς κωφοὺς ποιεῖ ἀκούειν καὶ ἀλάλους λαλεῖν.

controles.web: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!”
controles.kjv: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
controles.livre: E ficavam muito admirados, dizendo: Ele faz tudo bem! Aos surdos faz ouvir, e aos mudos falar.
